description: White background. Black title text 'A CAVEMAN' / 'EXPLAINS' at top and 'CAPITALISM' at bottom. Centre: caveman in yellow leopard-spot tunic wearing black sunglasses, arms crossed, scowling bearded face, standing.

Same title text and layout. Caveman redrawn without sunglasses: left hand raised holding two small lollipop-like items on sticks (upper left), right hand holding a padlock-like or brain-like object (right). Different pose and props in same frame position. Single changed frame.
Caveman without sunglasses holding two small stick-items in left hand and a padlock-shaped object in right hand; neutral face. Title text unchanged.
Same title text. Caveman redrawn: one foot on a stone block, hand holding a pole with a US-style flag (stars and stripes) at right, frowning. Props from previous pose gone.
Caveman with foot on block holding US-style flag on pole, squinting frown. Title text 'A CAVEMAN EXPLAINS' / 'CAPITALISM' unchanged.

Title text removed. New composition: larger caveman in leopard tunic with round white glasses, mouth wide open laughing or shouting, both hands raised, at left; at right a small coil/tesla-like device on a base with black zigzag spark lines. Plain white background.
Same drawing as final tile of G0006: laughing caveman with round glasses, hands raised, coil device with spark lines at right.
New scene: caveman seated inside a simple A-frame tent drawn with black lines, scowling, holding a bowl, yellow tunic. Cardboard sign at right reads 'WILL HUNT FOR FIRE'. White background.
Caveman seated in A-frame tent with bowl, frowning; sign reads 'WILL HUNT FOR FIRE'.
Tent and sign gone. Caveman standing large, centred, in yellow leopard tunic, wide-eyed worried face with glasses, mouth open, sweat marks around head, arms at sides.
Same worried caveman with glasses, standing, sweat marks, mouth open; drawn smaller within frame than in G0010 first tile (size differs, may be tile scaling; held state). Yellow tunic present.
Caveman now larger, naked (no tunic), sad closed-eyed frown, head bowed, arms hanging; large solid black oval hole in his belly; small black loincloth square. No glasses. Bearded.
Sad naked caveman with solid black oval hole in belly, eyes closed, arms hanging.
Within the black belly hole a small white ghost or spirit figure with angry face and tail appears. Rest of the figure unchanged. Small changed fraction.
Sad naked caveman with black belly hole containing small white ghost-like spirit with grumpy face and curled tail. Last frame of the clip.
